# cacls.exe is all Rust (cacls-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/cacls-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# cacls.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/cacls-rust/src/cacls/cacls.rs)
add_cargo_module(cacls cacls-cargo cacls.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE cacls-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS xdk psdk)
